question: In the State Legislature, ____________ is subject to dissolution.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Legislative Assembly**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Legislative Assembly** is the lower house of the State Legislature in India.
 
• It is subject to **dissolution**, meaning it can be disbanded either at the end of its term (normally **five years**) or earlier if the Governor decides based on recommendations by the Chief Minister.
 
• The dissolution process usually happens when the ruling government loses majority or in cases of emergency as outlined in the **Constitution of India**.
